testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, forms, filters, modals, navigation items, diagnostic submit buttons MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="nav-link-why-us", data-testid="diagnostic-booking-submit", data-testid="framework-stage-immersion").

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the design radiates top-tier executive consulting authority (McKinsey / Bain editorial feel with modern AI precision).
All navigation links and page routing (Home, Why Us, Services, Case Studies, Insights, About, Contact) must be fully functional.
Implement the 45-min diagnostic booking workflow as an interactive multi-step modal and standalone contact form with instant confirmation toasts using Sonner.
Support a light/dark theme toggle seamlessly with smooth contrast transitions.
Include data-testid on every interactive button, input, tab, card, and link.
